svg.title: How Recoup works
svg.desc: Read-only sources feed a fixed detection run: Claude reads vendor email into typed proposals, code checks each one, and deterministic detectors compare them with the ledger. Cases go to a review UI and a chat agent that can draft but not send. A person approves every message, and a case closes only when the credit posts on the ledger.
svg.text: Sources: every arrow in is read-only
Detection run: a fixed order, set by code
Recovery: the only way out is through a person
React, talks only to the API
local, or Gmail if turned on
1 of 10 Claude reads a vendor email: a refund was promised
2 of 10 Code checks the sender, the quote and the amount
3 of 10 No credit on the ledger: a missing refund
4 of 10 A case, with its evidence
5 of 10 A request is drafted from stored facts
6 of 10 A person reads it and slides to send
7 of 10 Sent to the address in the vendor directory
8 of 10 The vendor agrees. Not recovered yet
9 of 10 The credit posts on the ledger
10 of 10 Only now is the case Recovered
